استبرئوا (form X)
# اُسْتُبْرِئُوا (ustubriʔū) /us.tub.ri.ʔuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
# اِسْتَبْرِئُوا (istabriʔū) /is.tab.ri.ʔuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْرَأَ (istabraʔa)
